scope: RCL-owned bounded three-replica grow-counter join with safe-integer components, stale/reordered/duplicate delivery, partitions/healing, invalid sender rejection and source-owned monotone commit; actual HTTP packet replay with isolated target instances; no cryptographic member identity, cross-host deployment or arbitrary distributed-system claim; actual source-to-RBC-to-native-VM compiler workflow with observed process exits, compiler instruction metrics and source/artifact/result binding; local Windows pipeline, no external deployment or whole-family claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: Read only named frozen candidate batch; no other filesystem, memory, network, execution, writes or delegation

runtimeControls: actual compiler/VM process exits, compiler instruction and byte metrics
typed roots and source-owned transitions, wrong-root rejection; distributed profile additionally requires three real HTTP nodes

trials.intent: Join grow-counter snapshots by the maximum of each component, so duplicates and stale delivery never decrease a component and do not count increments twice.
Only replica identifiers zero, one and two belong to this group; reject every other sender before merging its counter components.
The replicator may commit valid merges when the explicit allowed input is true, and must refuse them when it is false. Preserve the replica.merge capability and current-input conditional authority.
